working_definition_ja: 競走結果に応じて馬主等へ支払われる賞金。
notes: P0-SRC-061. JRA owner guidance describes race prize payments and 本賞 as principal prize money.

working_definition_ja: 主に北米で競走の賞金総額を指す語。
notes: P0-SRC-062. Equibase official-industry program help uses Purse as the North American race-prize amount.

working_definition_ja: 一競走について公表される賞金・賞金原資の総額。配分対象や含有項目は制度で異なる。
notes: PB-SRC-001;PB-SRC-002;PB-SRC-003 show authority-published race prize funds/totals and placing distributions; composition varies by jurisdiction.

working_definition_ja: 競走の勝馬に対応して配分される賞金額。
notes: PB-SRC-001;PB-SRC-002 directly show first-place/winner prize allocations; percentages and beneficiaries remain jurisdiction-specific.

working_definition_ja: 2着以下を含む所定の着順に対して配分される賞金。対象着順や配分率は制度で異なる。
notes: PB-SRC-001;PB-SRC-002;PB-SRC-003 document prize distributions across multiple placings; do not universalize the number of paid places.

working_definition_ja: 基本的な賞金原資に加えて競走へ加算される金額を指す制度的表現。原資・扱いは地域で異なる。
notes: PB-SRC-004 supports the North American stakes-race sense of money added to a base purse through nomination/entry/starter fees; keep scope regional.

working_definition_ja: 条件達成等により追加で支払われる賞金。
notes: PB-SRC-002 confirms specific Breeder Bonus and Owner Bonus programmes, but the seed's generic global Bonus Concept remains too broad for promotion.

notes: PB-SRC-003 directly documents France Galop breeder premiums; PB-SRC-002 corroborates a separately named Australian breeder bonus without asserting identical rules.

working_definition_ja: 通常の競走賞金とは別枠で馬主へ追加支給されるプレミアム・奨励金。資格・算定は制度で異なる。
notes: PB-SRC-003 directly documents France Galop owner premiums; PB-SRC-002 corroborates a separately named Australian owner bonus while preserving system differences.
